track.text: Replayed over 33 months, the spend plan's revenue call landed within 7% in a typical month; its new-customer call was looser (typically off 15%). Made a full year ahead, the method behind the 2027 plan called annual revenue 7% high for Oct 2024–Sep 2025 and 3% low for Oct 2025–Sep 2026. Biggest miss: the Feb–Jul 2024 spend push, which won 35% fewer new customers than a straight-line plan expected.
